description: This is a shell script used for automating testing of OpenWrt packages, including environment setup, cleaning build directories, and executing package builds with specific options.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Executes make for a specified target with logging.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Removes all kernel build directories except the Linux kernel source.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified stamp file or symbolic link exists.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Tests a specified package by building it if necessary and handling build status.
